34568a6ecbefa629.description: Analytics Engineer Analytics Engineer At Swiss Re , we're on a mission to make the world more resilient, and we need bold, curious minds to help us get there. If you thrive at the intersection of data, AI, and real-world problem solving, this is your opportunity to work on the bleeding edge of technology and make a tangible impact on how decisions are made across our business. About the Role As an Analytics Engineer , you will be the critical bridge connecting our transactional systems with powerful analytical platforms, completing the loop from data capture to decision-making. You'll fuse large volumes of structured and unstructured data from our data lake with cutting-edge AI models and custom code, serving up queryable, high-quality, permissioned APIs that inform real decisions taken by real users. This is a role for someone who loves applying analytical thinking and programming expertise to solve complex, meaningful challenges in a fast-moving environment. Key Responsibilities Design and implement Agentic AI workflows that power intelligent, automated decision-making across business applications. Develop evaluation test suites to rigorously validate model correctness and ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs. Create safety guardrails to enable responsible, secure access to AI models in production environments. Write and review high-quality analytical Python code, ensuring appropriate architectural patterns and best practices are consistently applied. Manage and optimize Spark build pipelines to support efficient, large-scale data processing. Own operational production stability, including incident handling, application monitoring, and end-to-end testing to maintain platform reliability. Collaborate cross-functionally with product owners, engineers, and domain experts to translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions. About the Team Our Corporate Solutions Platforms team is a group of passionate technologists who believe that great software is built on a foundation of technical excellence and genuine collaboration. We design and implement carefully crafted applications that consistently exceed user expectations, working in close partnership with product owners to deliver real value. Quality and stability are at the heart of everything we do. We hold ourselves to high standards, lead by example, and embrace continuous improvement as a core part of how we work. If you care deeply about the craft of engineering and want to be part of a team that takes pride in what it builds, you'll feel right at home here. About You You are intellectually curious, analytically minded, and genuinely excited about the possibilities that AI and big data bring to business intelligence. You understand the fundamentals of machine learning and stay actively up to date with emerging AI models and developments in this fast-moving space. You value diverse perspectives, communicate openly, and know how to thrive in a cross-functional team alongside product and engineering experts. You bring both rigor and creativity to your work and are energized by the challenge of turning complex data into meaningful insights. We are looking for candidates who have: Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with demonstrated experience writing and reviewing production-quality analytical code. Working knowledge of AI models, including how they are deployed and how they differ fundamentally from training traditional machine learning models. Hands-on experience, or a strong willingness to learn, large-scale SaaS data analytics platforms, with an understanding of how data flows from ingestion through to insight delivery. Nice to Have Experience with Agentic AI frameworks and designing autonomous workflow pipelines. Familiarity with MLOps practices, including model evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Experience building or working with evaluation and testing frameworks for AI/ML models. Knowledge of data lake architectures and working with both structured and unstructured data at scale. Experience with API design and development, particularly permissioned, queryable data APIs. A track record of continuous learning through certifications, side projects, open-source contributions, or active engagement with the AI/ML community. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in agile, cross-functional product and engineering teams. About Swiss Re Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our .

348aa1bdec25caaa.description: Proposal Writer Intern Department: Strategic Growth & Business Development Location: (Hybrid/Remote) Duration: 10-12 Weeks (Summer), Academic Semester, or Part-Time Pay Rate: Competitive Hourly + Performance Milestone Bonus About the Role In tech consulting, winning a new engagement often depends on who writes the proposal first. As a Proposal Writer Intern, you are the architect of our narrative in the sales room. You will be responsible for crafting compelling, accurate, and compliant responses to RFPs (Request for Proposals) and Request for Information (RFIs). You act as the bridge between complex technical capabilities and business value. A strong proposal wins a contract; your words directly impact revenue targets. This is a high-stakes, high-learning environment where attention to detail matters more than anything else. Key Responsibilities RFP Response Management: Lead the drafting of executive summaries, project scopes, and technical approaches in response to client RFPs. Solution Narrative: Collaborate with Pre-Sales Architects to translate technical solutions into business outcomes (e.g., "How our AI reduces fraud costs"). Compliance Checks: Review all proposal submissions for NDA compliance, confidentiality standards, and adherence to strict formatting guidelines. Competitive Analysis: Research competitors’ pricing models and solution claims to ensure our proposals highlight superior value propositions. Collaboration Support: Work within shared document systems (e.g., SharePoint, Dealroom) to manage versions, track changes, and coordinate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Budget Estimation Support: Assist in estimating effort hours and resources required for proposed solutions to ensure pricing is realistic. Quality Assurance: Perform final proofreading of bids to eliminate typos that could undermine professionalism before submission. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in English, Business Administration, Computer Science, or Technical Communication. Writing Excellence: Must possess impeccable grammar and sentence structure. Ability to write clearly for both C-Suite executives and technical stakeholders. Technical Fluency: While you don't need to code, you must understand the basics of our solutions (Cloud, Data, Security) so you aren't describing features that don't exist or sound implausible. Attention to Detail: Ability to proofread for inconsistencies in tone, formatting, and compliance without being "picky" but rather "precise." Deadline Resilience: Comfortable working on tight turnaround times (e.g., "Draft this 50-page proposal section by tomorrow morning"). Preferred Skills Microsoft Office Suite: Advanced proficiency in Word (Track Changes, Comments, Master Documents) is highly preferred. Collaboration Tools: Experience with SharePoint, Google Drive, or Salesforce (Service Cloud/CRM). Research Skills: Ability to quickly synthesize large amounts of technical documentation into readable text. Presentation Design: Familiarity with PowerPoint to create slide decks that support the written proposal. Why Join Our Proposal Team? Deal Impact: See your writing directly influence the revenue forecast and win/loss analysis for the firm. Technical Exposure: Get a deep dive into our technology stack without needing to be an engineer—you just need to understand it well enough to sell it. Career Pathway: Excellent conversion path into full-time roles as Business Development Manager, Pre-Sales Consultant, or Solution Architect. Mentorship: Weekly 1-on-1 coaching from Senior Pre-Sales Directors on how to structure winning arguments and handle client objections. The Consulting Mindset Accuracy is Everything: If you write a technical solution in the proposal, it must be delivered exactly as described. No exaggeration. Confidentiality: You will sign strict NDAs. This role handles sensitive client data and proprietary pricing models. Speed with Quality: We value fast turnaround without sacrificing quality or accuracy. How to Apply Please submit your resume and two writing samples. Writing samples should include a formal report, essay, or technical document that demonstrates your ability to write clearly under structure. ZLG is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity in tech consulting.

3404e42ef9ee2a44.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious AI startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you’ll have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

What you’ll do

India is producing a new generation of ambitious, AI-native companies built for global markets, while global businesses increasingly look to India for growth. As Head of Sales, India, you will shape Stripe’s role in this transformation, helping businesses expand across the India-US corridor and beyond. This is a rare opportunity to build a category-defining sales organization at the intersection of AI, global commerce, and India’s digital economy.

As Head of Sales, India, you will own Stripe’s sales strategy and revenue outcomes across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Startups, with a primary focus on Enterprise. Reporting to the India MD, you will build and lead a high-performing team of Account Executives, establish the operating model for Stripe’s next phase of growth, and work directly with senior customers on their most important business challenges. You will also partner closely with Stripe’s regional and global leadership to shape our broader growth agenda for India.

We’re looking for a proactive leader who has demonstrated success operating in a high-growth environment, building and leading high-performing teams, and working through ambiguity with limited oversight. The ideal candidate has experience scaling a technology sales organization and brings strong business judgment, analytical ability, communication skills, and relationship-building skills.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Stripe’s sales and go-to-market strategy across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Startups segment, with a primary focus on Enterprise and India’s AI-native and globally ambitious technology companies.
  • Build Stripe’s position across the India-US corridor, working with regional teams to help Indian businesses expand globally and global businesses grow in India.
  • Translate customer and market insights into clear priorities and input for Stripe’s product and solutions roadmap.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of sales professionals.
  • Set the long-term vision for the India sales organization, establish a rigorous operating cadence, and drive predictable execution against key sales metrics.
  • Be accountable for revenue growth, new customer acquisition, and the expansion of Stripe’s business in India.
  • Coach the team in consultative and solution-based selling across every stage of the sales cycle.
  • Build and maintain enduring relationships with customers, including senior executives and C-level leaders.
  • Support the development and career growth of team members while increasing their impact at Stripe.
  • Work collaboratively across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to shape Stripe’s products and solutions around customer and market needs.
  • Represent Stripe at relevant industry events and build awareness of Stripe in the Indian market.

What success looks like

In your first 12 to 18 months, you will have established a clear growth strategy, strengthened and scaled the sales organization, deepened Stripe’s relationships with India’s leading companies, and built a more predictable, high-performing revenue engine.

Who you are

You are a builder who has materially scaled a technology business, recruited and developed exceptional sales talent, and won the trust of sophisticated enterprise customers. You combine strategic ambition with operating discipline and are equally comfortable shaping a multi-year market strategy, coaching a team, and engaging a CEO on their most important growth priorities.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years of people management experience.
  • Experience leading sales teams in a high-growth technology environment.
  • Demonstrated success selling to and building relationships with enterprise customers in India.
  • Experience developing and executing sales strategies across multiple customer segments.
  • Ability to recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing sales team.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to make sound decisions in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
  • Ability to build strategic relationships with senior executives, customers, partners, and industry leaders.
  • Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts and translate them into relevant business outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience working collaboratively across functions to deliver results.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading sales across Enterprise, Mid-Market, or Startups customer segments, with significant Enterprise experience.
  • Experience scaling a sales organization or business in India.
  • Experience in financial technology, payments, software, or another technology-led industry.
  • Demonstrated interest in startups, technology businesses, and the changing financial-services landscape in India.

About Certinal:

Certinal is a unified Consent & Compliance Platform that replaces paper-based consent, manual intake, and uncontrolled forms with a single, fully digital system built for enterprise organizations. It digitally captures patient consent, enables legally binding electronic signatures, and ensures compliance with major regulations including HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, SOC 2 Type II, and CMS-0053-F, while integrating directly with EHR systems like Epic and Oracle Cerner.

Position Overview:

Certinal is looking for a Associate Product Manager to support the product team across discovery, specification and delivery for our e-Signature and e-Consent platform. You will work closely with engineering, design, sales and customer success to turn customer problems into shipped, well-defined product.
This is an execution-focused role for someone early in their product career. You will write the stories, chase the details, keep the backlog honest and make sure what ships matches what was agreed. Because Certinal operates in regulated healthcare, you will also learn to treat audit trails, evidence and compliance requirements as first-class product concerns rather than afterthoughts.

Experience: 1 to 4 years in product management or a closely related role, including a minimum of 1 year in healthcare SaaS.

Key Responsibilities
• Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirement documents from agreed problem statements.
• Groom and maintain the backlog alongside engineering and QA, and keep priorities, dependencies and status current.
• Participate in sprint planning, refinement and review, and unblock engineering questions during the sprint.
• Triage customer feedback, support tickets and field requests into themes with evidence and frequency attached.
• Run structured competitive teardowns of e-signature and e-consent products and keep a living comparison current.
• Translate regulatory and security requirements into testable acceptance criteria in partnership with Pre-Sales and Engineering.
• Support release planning, write release notes, and prepare internal enablement material for Sales and Customer Success.
• Track adoption, funnel and usage metrics in product analytics, and report on how shipped features actually perform.
• Assist with beta and pilot programmes, including participant selection, feedback capture and readout.
• Contribute to user research: interview scheduling, note-taking, synthesis and sharing findings with the team.
• Maintain product documentation so that internal teams have one accurate source of truth.

Skills & Experience Requirements
• 1 to 4 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or an engineering, consulting or customer-facing role with clear product exposure.
• Strong written communication; able to write a requirement that an engineer can build from without a follow-up meeting.
• Structured problem-solving and comfort breaking an ambiguous request into scoped, sequenced work.
• Hands-on experience with an issue tracker such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
• Working familiarity with Figma and the ability to review and give useful feedback on designs.
• Basic SQL and comfort working with product analytics tools.
• Genuine curiosity about how enterprise software is bought, deployed and audited.
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or an equivalent analytical discipline.

Preferred
• Exposure to B2B or enterprise SaaS rather than consumer products.
• Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks and reading API documentation.
• Interest in or exposure to regulated domains such as healthcare, financial services or clinical research.
• Experience using AI tooling to accelerate research, synthesis or documentation work.
• Prior internship or project work in product management.

Why Join Certinal?
• Real Ownership Early: Own features end to end rather than sitting on the edge of someone else’s roadmap.
• Learn a Hard Domain: Regulated healthcare product work builds judgement that transfers anywhere.
• Close to Customers: Direct exposure to enterprise buyers through Sales, Pre-Sales and Customer Success.
• Small Team, Short Loops: Decisions get made quickly and you will see your work ship.
• Learning & Development: Professional development budget and mentorship from senior product leadership.

34c26b5909ee3d6a.description:
Headquarters: Ontario, Canada (Remote)

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

Team-Agnostic Placement

We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.

What You'll Do

• Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It’s not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

• Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like.

• Own the full stack. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. You don't hand off at a layer boundary. You own the outcome.

• Obsess over craft. Reliability and responsiveness are design concerns, not afterthoughts. Care about how the interface holds up when stakes are high.

• Champion observability. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand and improve your systems. Operational data drives stability, not just incident response.

• Pick up slack. You'll notice gaps and close them — not because you were asked, but because that's the standard we hold ourselves to.

What You'll Bring

• AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short. 

• A track record of shipping. You've built something real and put it in front of users. 3+ years of production full-stack experience.

• Full-stack depth. Strong React and TypeScript. Comfortable owning backend services in Go: API design, data modeling, service integration.

• System design. You think about architecture, not just features. You make conscious tradeoffs and document your reasoning.

• Production mindset. Latency, responsiveness, and reliability are design concerns. You're comfortable operating services in a distributed environment.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
